functions.definition:
CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION app_rls.printing_connector_identity(p_kind text, p_agent_id text, p_device_fingerprint text, p_printer_selector text, p_gateway_id text, p_gateway_secret_hash text, p_operation text)
 RETURNS jsonb
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO 'pg_catalog', 'public'
AS $function$
DECLARE registration record; printer_row record; attestation_row record;
  now_at timestamp without time zone:=transaction_timestamp();
BEGIN
  IF session_user<>'mscqr_prd_rls_phase2_app' OR p_kind NOT IN ('LOCAL_AGENT','SITE_GATEWAY')
     OR p_operation NOT IN ('VERIFY','HEARTBEAT')
     OR length(coalesce(p_agent_id,''))>180 OR length(coalesce(p_device_fingerprint,''))>256
     OR length(coalesce(p_printer_selector,''))>180 OR length(coalesce(p_gateway_id,''))>180
     OR (p_gateway_secret_hash IS NOT NULL AND p_gateway_secret_hash !~ '^[0-9a-f]{64}$')
  THEN RAISE EXCEPTION 'CONNECTOR_BOUNDARY_DENIED' USING ERRCODE='42501'; END IF;
  PERFORM set_config('app.printing_operation','printing-connector-identity',true),
          set_config('app.printing_agent_id',coalesce(p_agent_id,''),true),
          set_config('app.printing_device_fingerprint',coalesce(p_device_fingerprint,''),true),
          set_config('app.printing_gateway_id',coalesce(p_gateway_id,''),true),
          set_config('app.printing_gateway_secret_hash',coalesce(p_gateway_secret_hash,''),true);
  IF p_kind='LOCAL_AGENT' THEN
    SELECT pr.id,pr."userId",pr."orgId",pr."licenseeId",pr."agentId",pr."deviceFingerprint",
      pr."publicKeyPem",pr."certFingerprint",pr."trustStatus",pr."approvedAt",pr."revokedAt",pr."lastSeenAt"
      INTO STRICT registration FROM public."PrinterRegistration" pr
      WHERE pr."agentId"=p_agent_id AND pr."deviceFingerprint"=p_device_fingerprint
        AND pr."trustStatus"='TRUSTED' AND pr."revokedAt" IS NULL
      ORDER BY pr."lastSeenAt" DESC NULLS LAST,pr."updatedAt" DESC LIMIT 1;
    PERFORM set_config('app.printing_registration_id',registration.id,true),
            set_config('app.printing_user_id',registration."userId",true);
    SELECT p.id,p.name,p.vendor,p.model,p."connectionType",p."commandLanguage",p."ipAddress",p.host,p.port,
      p."resourcePath",p."tlsEnabled",p."printerUri",p."deliveryMode",p."gatewayId",p."gatewayLastSeenAt",
      p."gatewayStatus",p."gatewayLastError",p."nativePrinterId",p."agentId",p."deviceFingerprint",
      p."printerRegistrationId",p."orgId",p."licenseeId",p."assignedUserId",p."createdByUserId",
      p."isActive",p."isDefault",p."lastSeenAt",p."lastValidatedAt",p."lastValidationStatus",
      p."lastValidationMessage",p."capabilitySummary",p."calibrationProfile",p.metadata,p."createdAt",p."updatedAt"
      INTO STRICT printer_row FROM public."Printer" p
      WHERE p."printerRegistrationId"=registration.id AND p."isActive"
        AND (p.id=p_printer_selector OR p."nativePrinterId"=p_printer_selector)
      ORDER BY (p.id=p_printer_selector) DESC,p."isDefault" DESC,p."updatedAt" DESC LIMIT 1;
    PERFORM set_config('app.printing_printer_id',printer_row.id,true);
    SELECT pa."signatureValid",pa."trustValid",pa."expiresAt",pa.metadata
      INTO attestation_row FROM public."PrinterAttestation" pa
      WHERE pa."printerRegistrationId"=registration.id
        AND NOT (pa.metadata ? 'operation')
      ORDER BY pa."createdAt" DESC,pa.id DESC LIMIT 1;
    PERFORM set_config('app.printing_agent_session_id',
      coalesce(attestation_row.metadata->>'sessionId',''),true);
    IF p_operation='HEARTBEAT' THEN
      UPDATE public."PrinterRegistration" SET "lastSeenAt"=now_at,"updatedAt"=now_at WHERE id=registration.id;
      UPDATE public."Printer" SET "lastSeenAt"=now_at,"updatedAt"=now_at WHERE id=printer_row.id;
    END IF;
    RETURN jsonb_build_object(
      'registration',jsonb_build_object(
        'id',registration.id,'userId',registration."userId",'orgId',registration."orgId",
        'licenseeId',registration."licenseeId",'agentId',registration."agentId",
        'deviceFingerprint',registration."deviceFingerprint",'publicKeyPem',registration."publicKeyPem",
        'certFingerprint',registration."certFingerprint",
        'trustStatus',registration."trustStatus",'approvedAt',registration."approvedAt",
        'revokedAt',registration."revokedAt",'lastSeenAt',registration."lastSeenAt"
      ),
      'printer',to_jsonb(printer_row),
      'eligibleForPrinting',registration."publicKeyPem" LIKE '%BEGIN%' AND printer_row."isActive"
        AND attestation_row."signatureValid" AND attestation_row."trustValid"
        AND attestation_row."expiresAt">(clock_timestamp() AT TIME ZONE 'UTC')
        AND coalesce((attestation_row.metadata->>'connected')::boolean,false)
        AND (attestation_row.metadata->>'source' IS DISTINCT FROM 'PERSISTENT_SESSION'
          OR attestation_row.metadata->'printerHealth'->>'healthVersion'='1')
        AND coalesce(attestation_row.metadata->>'selectedPrinterId',attestation_row.metadata->>'printerId','')
          IN (printer_row.id,coalesce(printer_row."nativePrinterId",''))
        AND ((attestation_row.metadata->>'source' IS DISTINCT FROM 'PERSISTENT_SESSION' AND NOT EXISTS (
          SELECT 1 FROM public."PrinterAgentSession" prior
          WHERE prior."registrationId"=registration.id
        )) OR EXISTS (
          SELECT 1 FROM public."PrinterAgentSession" s
          WHERE s.id=attestation_row.metadata->>'sessionId' AND s."registrationId"=registration.id
            AND s."connectionState"='CONNECTED' AND s."revokedAt" IS NULL
            AND s."expiresAt">clock_timestamp()
            AND s."lastSignedHeartbeatAt">clock_timestamp()-interval '35 seconds'
            AND s."selectedPrinterId"=attestation_row.metadata->>'selectedPrinterId'
            AND s.metadata->>'printerId'=printer_row.id
            AND s.metadata->>'manufacturerId'=registration."userId"
            AND s.metadata->>'orgId' IS NOT DISTINCT FROM registration."orgId"
            AND s.metadata->>'licenseeId' IS NOT DISTINCT FROM registration."licenseeId"
        ))
    );
  END IF;
  SELECT p.id,p.name,p.vendor,p.model,p."connectionType",p."commandLanguage",p."ipAddress",p.host,p.port,
    p."resourcePath",p."tlsEnabled",p."printerUri",p."deliveryMode",p."gatewayId",p."gatewayLastSeenAt",
    p."gatewayStatus",p."gatewayLastError",p."nativePrinterId",p."agentId",p."deviceFingerprint",
    p."printerRegistrationId",p."orgId",p."licenseeId",p."assignedUserId",p."createdByUserId",
    p."isActive",p."isDefault",p."lastSeenAt",p."lastValidatedAt",p."lastValidationStatus",
    p."lastValidationMessage",p."capabilitySummary",p."calibrationProfile",p.metadata,p."createdAt",p."updatedAt"
    INTO STRICT printer_row FROM public."Printer" p
    WHERE p."gatewayId"=p_gateway_id AND p."gatewaySecretHash"=p_gateway_secret_hash
      AND p."deliveryMode"='SITE_GATEWAY' AND p."isActive"
      AND (p_printer_selector IS NULL OR p_printer_selector='' OR p.id=p_printer_selector);
  PERFORM set_config('app.printing_printer_id',printer_row.id,true);
  IF p_operation='HEARTBEAT' THEN
    UPDATE public."Printer" SET "gatewayLastSeenAt"=now_at,"gatewayStatus"='ONLINE',
      "gatewayLastError"=NULL,"updatedAt"=now_at WHERE id=printer_row.id;
  END IF;
  RETURN jsonb_build_object('printer',to_jsonb(printer_row),'eligibleForPrinting',true);
END
$function$

functions.signature: app_rls.printing_connector_registration(p_capability text, p_purpose text, p_request_id text, p_operation text, p_payload jsonb)
functions.definition:
CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION app_rls.printing_connector_registration(p_capability text, p_purpose text, p_request_id text, p_operation text, p_payload jsonb)
 RETURNS jsonb
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO 'pg_catalog', 'public'
AS $function$
DECLARE
  actor record;
  registration record;
  printer_input jsonb;
  printer_id text;
  native_id text;
  printer_name text;
  now_at timestamp without time zone:=transaction_timestamp();
  expires_at timestamp without time zone;
  trust_valid boolean;
BEGIN
  IF p_purpose<>'printing-connector-registration'
     OR p_operation NOT IN ('LOOKUP','HEARTBEAT')
     OR jsonb_typeof(coalesce(p_payload,'{}'::jsonb))<>'object'
  THEN RAISE EXCEPTION 'PRINTING_BOUNDARY_DENIED' USING ERRCODE='42501'; END IF;
  SELECT * INTO STRICT actor
    FROM app_rls.printing_bind_actor(p_capability,p_purpose,p_request_id,NULL);
  IF actor.role<>'MANUFACTURER_ADMIN'
  THEN RAISE EXCEPTION 'PRINTING_BOUNDARY_DENIED' USING ERRCODE='42501'; END IF;
  PERFORM set_config('app.printing_operation','printing-connector-registration-'||lower(p_operation),true),
          set_config('app.printing_user_id',actor."userId",true);

  IF p_operation='LOOKUP' THEN
    SELECT pr.id,pr."userId",pr."orgId",pr."licenseeId",pr."deviceFingerprint",pr."agentId",
      pr."publicKeyPem",pr."trustStatus",pr."revokedAt",pr."approvedAt",pr."lastSeenAt",pr."updatedAt"
      INTO registration
      FROM public."PrinterRegistration" pr
      WHERE pr."userId"=actor."userId" AND pr."revokedAt" IS NULL
        AND (
          nullif(p_payload->>'deviceFingerprint','') IS NULL
          OR pr."deviceFingerprint"=p_payload->>'deviceFingerprint'
        )
      ORDER BY pr."approvedAt" DESC NULLS LAST,pr."lastSeenAt" DESC NULLS LAST,pr."updatedAt" DESC
      LIMIT 1;
    RETURN CASE WHEN registration.id IS NULL THEN NULL ELSE jsonb_build_object(
      'id',registration.id,'agentId',registration."agentId",
      'deviceFingerprint',registration."deviceFingerprint",
      'publicKeyPem',registration."publicKeyPem",'trustStatus',registration."trustStatus",
      'revokedAt',registration."revokedAt"
    ) END;
  END IF;

  trust_valid:=coalesce((p_payload->>'signatureValid')::boolean,false)
    AND coalesce((p_payload->>'connected')::boolean,false);
  expires_at:=nullif(p_payload->>'expiresAt','')::timestamp without time zone;
  IF length(btrim(coalesce(p_payload->>'agentId',''))) NOT BETWEEN 1 AND 180
     OR length(btrim(coalesce(p_payload->>'deviceFingerprint',''))) NOT BETWEEN 8 AND 256
     OR p_payload->>'publicKeyPem' NOT LIKE '%BEGIN%PUBLIC KEY%'
     OR length(p_payload->>'publicKeyPem')>8000
     OR p_payload->>'signedPayloadHash' !~ '^[0-9a-f]{64}$'
     OR length(btrim(coalesce(p_payload->>'heartbeatNonce',''))) NOT BETWEEN 12 AND 180
     OR expires_at<=now_at OR expires_at>now_at+interval '15 minutes'
     OR jsonb_typeof(coalesce(p_payload->'metadata','{}'::jsonb))<>'object'
     OR jsonb_typeof(coalesce(p_payload->'printers','[]'::jsonb))<>'array'
     OR jsonb_array_length(coalesce(p_payload->'printers','[]'::jsonb))>50
  THEN RAISE EXCEPTION 'CONNECTOR_BOUNDARY_DENIED' USING ERRCODE='42501'; END IF;

  -- A reconnect or new identity cannot replace a fenced registration.
  PERFORM app_rls.printing_maintenance_gate(jsonb_build_array('local',pr.id)::text,'CHECK',NULL,'{}'::jsonb)
    FROM public."PrinterRegistration" pr WHERE pr."userId"=actor."userId";

  SELECT pr.id,pr."userId",pr."orgId",pr."licenseeId",pr."deviceFingerprint",pr."agentId",
    pr."publicKeyPem",pr."trustStatus",pr."revokedAt",pr."approvedAt",pr."lastSeenAt",pr."updatedAt"
    INTO registration
    FROM public."PrinterRegistration" pr
    WHERE pr."userId"=actor."userId"
      AND pr."deviceFingerprint"=btrim(p_payload->>'deviceFingerprint')
    FOR UPDATE;
  IF registration.id IS NULL THEN
    registration.id:=gen_random_uuid()::text;
    PERFORM set_config('app.printing_registration_id',registration.id,true);
    INSERT INTO public."PrinterRegistration"(
      id,"userId","orgId","licenseeId","deviceFingerprint","agentId","publicKeyPem",
      "certFingerprint","trustStatus","trustReason","approvedAt","lastSeenAt","createdAt","updatedAt"
    ) VALUES (
      registration.id,actor."userId",actor."organizationId",actor."licenseeId",
      btrim(p_payload->>'deviceFingerprint'),btrim(p_payload->>'agentId'),
      p_payload->>'publicKeyPem',nullif(p_payload->>'certFingerprint',''),
      CASE WHEN trust_valid THEN 'TRUSTED' ELSE 'FAILED' END::public."PrinterTrustStatus",
      CASE WHEN trust_valid THEN NULL ELSE left(coalesce(p_payload->>'rejectionReason','Signature verification failed'),500) END,
      CASE WHEN trust_valid THEN now_at END,now_at,now_at,now_at
    ) RETURNING id,"userId","orgId","licenseeId","deviceFingerprint","agentId","publicKeyPem",
      "trustStatus","revokedAt","approvedAt","lastSeenAt","updatedAt" INTO registration;
  ELSE
    PERFORM set_config('app.printing_registration_id',registration.id,true);
    IF registration."revokedAt" IS NOT NULL
       OR registration."trustStatus"='REVOKED'::public."PrinterTrustStatus"
    THEN RAISE EXCEPTION 'CONNECTOR_BOUNDARY_DENIED' USING ERRCODE='42501'; END IF;
    UPDATE public."PrinterRegistration" SET
      "orgId"=actor."organizationId","licenseeId"=actor."licenseeId",
      "agentId"=btrim(p_payload->>'agentId'),
      "publicKeyPem"=CASE WHEN trust_valid THEN p_payload->>'publicKeyPem' ELSE "publicKeyPem" END,
      "certFingerprint"=coalesce("certFingerprint",nullif(p_payload->>'certFingerprint','')),
      "trustStatus"=CASE WHEN trust_valid THEN 'TRUSTED' ELSE 'FAILED' END::public."PrinterTrustStatus",
      "trustReason"=CASE WHEN trust_valid THEN NULL ELSE left(coalesce(p_payload->>'rejectionReason','Signature verification failed'),500) END,
      "approvedAt"=CASE WHEN trust_valid THEN coalesce("approvedAt",now_at) ELSE "approvedAt" END,
      "lastSeenAt"=now_at,"updatedAt"=now_at
      WHERE id=registration.id
      RETURNING id,"userId","orgId","licenseeId","deviceFingerprint","agentId","publicKeyPem",
        "trustStatus","revokedAt","approvedAt","lastSeenAt","updatedAt" INTO registration;
  END IF;

  IF trust_valid THEN
    UPDATE public."PrinterRegistration"
      SET "trustStatus"='REVOKED',"trustReason"='Replaced by a newer signed connector registration',
          "revokedAt"=now_at,"updatedAt"=now_at
      WHERE "userId"=actor."userId" AND id<>registration.id AND "revokedAt" IS NULL;
  END IF;

  INSERT INTO public."PrinterAttestation"(
    id,"printerRegistrationId","signedPayloadHash","heartbeatNonce","attestedAt","expiresAt",
    "sourceIpHash","userAgentHash","mtlsFingerprint","signatureValid","trustValid",
    "rejectionReason",metadata,"createdAt"
  ) VALUES (
    gen_random_uuid()::text,registration.id,p_payload->>'signedPayloadHash',
    btrim(p_payload->>'heartbeatNonce'),now_at,expires_at,
    nullif(p_payload->>'sourceIpHash',''),nullif(p_payload->>'userAgentHash',''),
    nullif(p_payload->>'certFingerprint',''),coalesce((p_payload->>'signatureValid')::boolean,false),
    trust_valid,nullif(left(p_payload->>'rejectionReason',500),''),
    coalesce(p_payload->'metadata','{}'::jsonb),now_at
  ) ON CONFLICT ("printerRegistrationId","heartbeatNonce") DO NOTHING;

  IF trust_valid THEN
    FOR printer_input IN SELECT value FROM jsonb_array_elements(coalesce(p_payload->'printers','[]'::jsonb))
    LOOP
      native_id:=left(btrim(coalesce(printer_input->>'printerId',printer_input->>'id','')),180);
      printer_name:=left(btrim(coalesce(printer_input->>'printerName',printer_input->>'name','')),180);
      IF native_id='' OR printer_name='' THEN CONTINUE; END IF;
      SELECT p.id INTO printer_id FROM public."Printer" p
        WHERE p."printerRegistrationId"=registration.id AND p."nativePrinterId"=native_id
        FOR UPDATE;
      printer_id:=coalesce(printer_id,gen_random_uuid()::text);
      PERFORM set_config('app.printing_printer_id',printer_id,true);
      INSERT INTO public."Printer"(
        id,name,vendor,model,"connectionType","commandLanguage","nativePrinterId","agentId",
        "deviceFingerprint","printerRegistrationId","orgId","licenseeId","assignedUserId",
        "createdByUserId","isActive","isDefault","lastSeenAt","lastValidatedAt",
        "lastValidationStatus","capabilitySummary","calibrationProfile",metadata,"createdAt","updatedAt"
      ) VALUES (
        printer_id,printer_name,nullif(left(printer_input->>'vendor',180),''),
        nullif(left(printer_input->>'model',180),''),
        'LOCAL_AGENT'::public."PrinterConnectionType",
        coalesce(nullif(upper(printer_input->>'commandLanguage'),'')::public."PrinterCommandLanguage",
          'AUTO'::public."PrinterCommandLanguage"),
        native_id,registration."agentId",registration."deviceFingerprint",registration.id,
        actor."organizationId",actor."licenseeId",actor."userId",actor."userId",true,
        native_id=coalesce(p_payload->'metadata'->>'selectedPrinterId',p_payload->'metadata'->>'printerId'),
        now_at,now_at,'READY',printer_input->'capabilitySummary',
        p_payload->'metadata'->'calibrationProfile',
        jsonb_build_object('online',coalesce((printer_input->>'online')::boolean,true)),now_at,now_at
      )
      ON CONFLICT ("printerRegistrationId","nativePrinterId") DO UPDATE SET
        name=excluded.name,model=excluded.model,"agentId"=excluded."agentId",
        "deviceFingerprint"=excluded."deviceFingerprint","orgId"=excluded."orgId",
        "licenseeId"=excluded."licenseeId","assignedUserId"=excluded."assignedUserId",
        "isActive"=true,"isDefault"=excluded."isDefault","lastSeenAt"=now_at,
        "lastValidatedAt"=now_at,"lastValidationStatus"='READY',
        "capabilitySummary"=excluded."capabilitySummary",
        "calibrationProfile"=excluded."calibrationProfile",metadata=excluded.metadata,"updatedAt"=now_at;
    END LOOP;
  END IF;
  RETURN jsonb_build_object('registrationId',registration.id,'trusted',trust_valid,
    'trustStatus',registration."trustStatus",'idempotent',false);
END
$function$

functions.signature: app_rls.printing_connector_session(p_operation text, p_session_id text, p_registration_id text, p_payload jsonb)
functions.definition:
CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION app_rls.printing_connector_session(p_operation text, p_session_id text, p_registration_id text, p_payload jsonb)
 RETURNS jsonb
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO 'pg_catalog', 'public'
AS $function$
DECLARE registration record; printer_row record; session_row record;
  now_at timestamp without time zone;
  latest_attestation_expiry timestamp without time zone;
  latest_attestation_usable boolean;
  health_usable boolean;
  health_out_of_order boolean;
  health_observed_text text;
  health_observed_at timestamp without time zone;
  latest_health_observed_at timestamp without time zone;
  selected text := p_payload->>'selectedPrinterId';
  printer_id text := p_payload->>'printerId';
  next_seq integer;
  renewed boolean := false;
  signed_nonce text;
  attestation_nonce text;
  heartbeat_issued_at timestamp with time zone;
BEGIN
  IF session_user<>'mscqr_prd_rls_phase2_app' OR p_operation NOT IN ('OPEN','ADVANCE','CHECK','CLOSE')
     OR p_session_id !~* '^[0-9a-f]{8}-[0-9a-f]{4}-[1-5][0-9a-f]{3}-[89ab][0-9a-f]{3}-[0-9a-f]{12}$'
     OR p_registration_id !~* '^[0-9a-f]{8}-[0-9a-f]{4}-[1-5][0-9a-f]{3}-[89ab][0-9a-f]{3}-[0-9a-f]{12}$'
     OR jsonb_typeof(coalesce(p_payload,'null'::jsonb))<>'object'
  THEN RAISE EXCEPTION 'CONNECTOR_SESSION_DENIED' USING ERRCODE='42501'; END IF;
  PERFORM set_config('app.printing_operation','printing-connector-session',true),
          set_config('app.printing_registration_id',p_registration_id,true),
          set_config('app.printing_agent_session_id',p_session_id,true),
          set_config('app.printing_printer_id',coalesce(printer_id,''),true);
  SELECT r.id,r."userId",r."orgId",r."licenseeId",r."agentId",r."deviceFingerprint",
         r."publicKeyPem",r."certFingerprint",r."trustStatus",r."revokedAt"
    INTO STRICT registration FROM public."PrinterRegistration" r
    WHERE r.id=p_registration_id FOR UPDATE;
  IF coalesce(registration."publicKeyPem",'')='' OR registration."agentId" IS DISTINCT FROM p_payload->>'agentId'
     OR registration."deviceFingerprint" IS DISTINCT FROM p_payload->>'deviceFingerprint'
     OR encode(sha256(convert_to(registration."publicKeyPem",'UTF8')),'hex') IS DISTINCT FROM p_payload->>'publicKeyFingerprint'
  THEN RAISE EXCEPTION 'CONNECTOR_SESSION_DENIED' USING ERRCODE='42501'; END IF;
  IF p_operation='CLOSE' THEN
    SELECT s.id,s."registrationId",s."agentId",s."deviceFingerprint",s."publicKeyFingerprint",
           s."selectedPrinterId"
      INTO STRICT session_row FROM public."PrinterAgentSession" s WHERE s.id=p_session_id FOR UPDATE;
    IF session_row."registrationId"<>registration.id OR session_row."agentId"<>registration."agentId"
       OR session_row."deviceFingerprint"<>registration."deviceFingerprint"
       OR session_row."publicKeyFingerprint"<>p_payload->>'publicKeyFingerprint'
       OR session_row."selectedPrinterId"<>selected
    THEN RAISE EXCEPTION 'CONNECTOR_SESSION_DENIED' USING ERRCODE='42501'; END IF;
    now_at := clock_timestamp() AT TIME ZONE 'UTC';
    UPDATE public."PrinterAgentSession" SET "connectionState"='DISCONNECTED',"revokedAt"=now_at,
      "disconnectedAt"=now_at,"closeReason"=left(coalesce(p_payload->>'reason','socket_closed'),120),"updatedAt"=now_at
      WHERE id=session_row.id AND "connectionState"='CONNECTED';
    RETURN jsonb_build_object('sessionId',p_session_id,'state','DISCONNECTED');
  END IF;
  IF registration."trustStatus"<>'TRUSTED' OR registration."revokedAt" IS NOT NULL
  THEN RAISE EXCEPTION 'CONNECTOR_SESSION_DENIED' USING ERRCODE='42501'; END IF;
  SELECT p.id,p.name,p."orgId",p."licenseeId",p."assignedUserId",p."nativePrinterId",p."agentId",p."deviceFingerprint"
    INTO STRICT printer_row FROM public."Printer" p
    WHERE p.id=printer_id AND p."printerRegistrationId"=registration.id AND p."isActive"
      AND (p.id=selected OR p."nativePrinterId"=selected) FOR UPDATE;
  IF printer_row."orgId" IS DISTINCT FROM registration."orgId"
     OR printer_row."licenseeId" IS DISTINCT FROM registration."licenseeId"
     OR printer_row."assignedUserId" IS DISTINCT FROM registration."userId"
     OR printer_row."agentId" IS DISTINCT FROM registration."agentId"
     OR printer_row."deviceFingerprint" IS DISTINCT FROM registration."deviceFingerprint"
  THEN RAISE EXCEPTION 'CONNECTOR_SESSION_DENIED' USING ERRCODE='42501'; END IF;
  now_at := clock_timestamp() AT TIME ZONE 'UTC';
  IF p_operation='OPEN' THEN
    IF p_payload->>'connectionId' !~* '^[0-9a-f]{8}-[0-9a-f]{4}-[1-5][0-9a-f]{3}-[89ab][0-9a-f]{3}-[0-9a-f]{12}$'
       OR coalesce(length(selected),0)=0 OR length(selected)>180
       OR coalesce(length(p_payload->>'helloNonce'),0) NOT BETWEEN 8 AND 180
       OR coalesce((p_payload->>'expirySeconds')::integer,0) NOT BETWEEN 60 AND 86400
    THEN RAISE EXCEPTION 'CONNECTOR_SESSION_DENIED' USING ERRCODE='42501'; END IF;
    -- The registration lock serializes OPEN across backend instances. Retain the
    -- signed hello nonce on all session rows so a replay cannot replace authority.
    IF EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM public."PrinterAgentSession" s
      WHERE s."registrationId"=registration.id
        AND s.metadata->>'helloNonce'=p_payload->>'helloNonce')
    THEN RAISE EXCEPTION 'CONNECTOR_SESSION_REPLAY' USING ERRCODE='23505'; END IF;
    UPDATE public."PrinterAgentSession" SET "connectionState"='SUPERSEDED',"revokedAt"=now_at,
      "disconnectedAt"=now_at,"closeReason"='session_replaced',"updatedAt"=now_at
      WHERE "registrationId"=registration.id AND "connectionState"='CONNECTED' AND "revokedAt" IS NULL;
    INSERT INTO public."PrinterAgentSession"(id,"connectionId","registrationId","agentId",
      "deviceFingerprint","publicKeyFingerprint","selectedPrinterId","selectedPrinterName",
      "connectorVersion","connectionState","lastMessageSeq","connectedAt","lastSeenAt",
      "lastSignedHeartbeatAt","expiresAt",metadata,"createdAt","updatedAt")
    VALUES(p_session_id,p_payload->>'connectionId',registration.id,registration."agentId",
      registration."deviceFingerprint",p_payload->>'publicKeyFingerprint',selected,
      left(p_payload->>'selectedPrinterName',180),left(p_payload->>'connectorVersion',80),
      'CONNECTED',0,now_at,now_at,'epoch'::timestamp,now_at+make_interval(secs=>(p_payload->>'expirySeconds')::integer),
      jsonb_build_object('manufacturerId',registration."userId",'orgId',registration."orgId",
        'licenseeId',registration."licenseeId",'printerId',printer_row.id,
        'connectorVersion',left(p_payload->>'connectorVersion',80),
        'helloNonce',p_payload->>'helloNonce'),now_at,now_at);
    RETURN jsonb_build_object('sessionId',p_session_id,'state','CONNECTED','lastMessageSeq',0);
  END IF;
  SELECT s.id,s."registrationId",s."agentId",s."deviceFingerprint",s."publicKeyFingerprint",
         s."selectedPrinterId",s."connectionState",s."expiresAt",s."revokedAt",s."lastMessageSeq",
         s."lastSignedHeartbeatAt",s.metadata
    INTO STRICT session_row FROM public."PrinterAgentSession" s WHERE s.id=p_session_id FOR UPDATE;
  IF session_row."registrationId"<>registration.id OR session_row."agentId"<>registration."agentId"
     OR session_row."deviceFingerprint"<>registration."deviceFingerprint"
     OR session_row."publicKeyFingerprint"<>p_payload->>'publicKeyFingerprint'
     OR session_row."selectedPrinterId"<>selected
     OR session_row.metadata->>'manufacturerId' IS DISTINCT FROM registration."userId"
     OR session_row.metadata->>'orgId' IS DISTINCT FROM registration."orgId"
     OR session_row.metadata->>'licenseeId' IS DISTINCT FROM registration."licenseeId"
     OR session_row.metadata->>'printerId' IS DISTINCT FROM printer_row.id
  THEN RAISE EXCEPTION 'CONNECTOR_SESSION_DENIED' USING ERRCODE='42501'; END IF;
  now_at := clock_timestamp() AT TIME ZONE 'UTC';
  IF session_row."connectionState"<>'CONNECTED' OR session_row."revokedAt" IS NOT NULL
     OR session_row."expiresAt" IS NULL OR session_row."expiresAt"<=now_at
  THEN RAISE EXCEPTION 'CONNECTOR_SESSION_NOT_ACTIVE' USING ERRCODE='42501'; END IF;
  IF p_operation='CHECK' AND (session_row."lastSignedHeartbeatAt"<=now_at-interval '35 seconds'
    OR NOT coalesce((
    SELECT pa.metadata->>'sessionId'=p_session_id
      AND pa.metadata->>'selectedPrinterId'=selected
      AND pa."signatureValid" AND pa."trustValid" AND pa."expiresAt">now_at
      AND pa.metadata->'printerHealth'->>'healthVersion'='1'
      AND pa.metadata->>'connected'='true'
    FROM public."PrinterAttestation" pa WHERE pa."printerRegistrationId"=registration.id
      AND pa.metadata->>'source'='PERSISTENT_SESSION' AND NOT (pa.metadata ? 'operation')
    ORDER BY pa."createdAt" DESC,pa.id DESC LIMIT 1
  ),false)) THEN RAISE EXCEPTION 'PRINTER_HEALTH_NOT_READY' USING ERRCODE='42501'; END IF;
  IF p_operation='ADVANCE' THEN
    IF p_payload->>'messageSeq' !~ '^[1-9][0-9]{0,9}$'
    THEN RAISE EXCEPTION 'CONNECTOR_SESSION_DENIED' USING ERRCODE='42501'; END IF;
    next_seq := (p_payload->>'messageSeq')::integer;
    IF next_seq<=session_row."lastMessageSeq" THEN
      RAISE EXCEPTION 'CONNECTOR_SESSION_REPLAY' USING ERRCODE='23505';
    END IF;
    IF p_payload->>'messageType'='heartbeat' THEN
      signed_nonce := p_payload->>'heartbeatNonce';
      heartbeat_issued_at := nullif(p_payload->>'heartbeatIssuedAt','')::timestamp with time zone;
      IF coalesce((p_payload->>'signatureVerified')::boolean,false) IS NOT TRUE
         OR p_payload->>'signedPayloadHash' !~ '^[0-9a-f]{64}$'
         OR p_payload->>'signatureHash' !~ '^[0-9a-f]{64}$'
         OR length(coalesce(signed_nonce,'')) NOT BETWEEN 8 AND 180
         OR heartbeat_issued_at IS NULL
         OR abs(extract(epoch FROM (clock_timestamp()-heartbeat_issued_at)))>180
      THEN RAISE EXCEPTION 'CONNECTOR_SESSION_DENIED' USING ERRCODE='42501'; END IF;
      health_observed_text := p_payload->'printerHealth'->>'observedAt';
      health_observed_at := NULL;
      IF jsonb_typeof(p_payload->'printerHealth')='object'
         AND jsonb_typeof(p_payload->'printerHealth'->'observedAt')='string'
         AND health_observed_text ~ '^[0-9]{4}-[0-9]{2}-[0-9]{2}T[0-9]{2}:[0-9]{2}:[0-9]{2}(\.[0-9]{1,6})?(Z|[+-][0-9]{2}:[0-9]{2})$'
         AND pg_catalog.pg_input_is_valid(health_observed_text,'timestamp with time zone')
      THEN
        health_observed_at := health_observed_text::timestamptz AT TIME ZONE 'UTC';
      END IF;
      health_usable := coalesce(
        p_payload->'printerHealth'->>'healthVersion'='1'
        AND p_payload->'printerHealth'->>'selectedPrinterId'=selected
        AND p_payload->'printerHealth'->>'discovered'='true'
        AND p_payload->'printerHealth'->>'queueAvailable'='true'
        AND p_payload->'printerHealth'->>'online'='true'
        AND health_observed_at>now_at-interval '20 seconds'
        AND health_observed_at<=now_at+interval '5 seconds',false);
      SELECT pa."expiresAt",
        pa."signatureValid" AND pa."trustValid"
          AND coalesce((pa.metadata->>'connected')::boolean,false)
        AND (pa.metadata->>'source' IS DISTINCT FROM 'PERSISTENT_SESSION'
          OR pa.metadata->'printerHealth'->>'healthVersion'='1')
        AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM public."PrinterAttestation" newer
          WHERE newer."printerRegistrationId"=pa."printerRegistrationId"
            AND newer.metadata->>'source'='PERSISTENT_SESSION'
            AND (newer."createdAt",newer.id)>(pa."createdAt",pa.id))
          AND pa.metadata->>'source'='PERSISTENT_SESSION'
          AND pa.metadata->>'sessionId'=p_session_id
          AND coalesce(pa.metadata->>'selectedPrinterId',pa.metadata->>'printerId','')
            IN (printer_row.id,coalesce(printer_row."nativePrinterId",''))
        INTO latest_attestation_expiry,latest_attestation_usable
        FROM public."PrinterAttestation" pa
        WHERE pa."printerRegistrationId"=registration.id AND NOT (pa.metadata ? 'operation')
        ORDER BY pa."createdAt" DESC,pa.id DESC LIMIT 1;
      SELECT max(candidate.observed_at) INTO latest_health_observed_at
        FROM (SELECT pa."createdAt",
          CASE WHEN jsonb_typeof(pa.metadata->'printerHealth'->'observedAt')='string'
            AND pa.metadata->'printerHealth'->>'observedAt' ~ '^[0-9]{4}-[0-9]{2}-[0-9]{2}T[0-9]{2}:[0-9]{2}:[0-9]{2}(\.[0-9]{1,6})?(Z|[+-][0-9]{2}:[0-9]{2})$'
            AND pg_catalog.pg_input_is_valid(pa.metadata->'printerHealth'->>'observedAt','timestamp with time zone')
          THEN (pa.metadata->'printerHealth'->>'observedAt')::timestamptz AT TIME ZONE 'UTC'
          END AS observed_at
          FROM public."PrinterAttestation" pa
          WHERE pa."printerRegistrationId"=registration.id AND pa.metadata->>'sessionId'=p_session_id
            AND pa.metadata->>'source'='PERSISTENT_SESSION'
            AND pa.metadata->'printerHealth'->>'healthVersion'='1') candidate
        WHERE candidate.observed_at>candidate."createdAt"-interval '20 seconds'
          AND candidate.observed_at<=candidate."createdAt"+interval '5 seconds';
      health_out_of_order := coalesce(health_observed_at<=latest_health_observed_at,false);
      -- A newly accepted signed message with unavailable or stale health must
      -- supersede the previous healthy attestation. Replayed sequences were
      -- rejected above; a still-fresh but older healthy observation is merely
      -- consumed and cannot extend authorization or displace newer evidence.
      IF NOT health_usable OR (NOT health_out_of_order AND (
         NOT coalesce(latest_attestation_usable,false)
         OR latest_attestation_expiry IS NULL OR latest_attestation_expiry<=now_at+interval '25 seconds')) THEN
        attestation_nonce := encode(sha256(convert_to(
          p_session_id||'|'||next_seq::text||'|'||signed_nonce,'UTF8')),'hex');
        INSERT INTO public."PrinterAttestation"(
          id,"printerRegistrationId","signedPayloadHash","heartbeatNonce","attestedAt","expiresAt",
          "mtlsFingerprint","signatureValid","trustValid",metadata,"createdAt"
        ) VALUES (
          gen_random_uuid()::text,registration.id,p_payload->>'signedPayloadHash',attestation_nonce,
          now_at,least(now_at+interval '35 seconds',coalesce(health_observed_at,now_at)+interval '35 seconds'),registration."certFingerprint",true,true,
          jsonb_build_object(
            'source','PERSISTENT_SESSION','sessionId',p_session_id,'messageSeq',next_seq,
            'signedMessageNonce',signed_nonce,'signatureHash',p_payload->>'signatureHash',
            'heartbeatIssuedAt',p_payload->>'heartbeatIssuedAt','connected',health_usable,
            'buildVersion',session_row.metadata->>'connectorVersion',
            'printerHealth',p_payload->'printerHealth',
            'printerId',printer_row.id,'selectedPrinterId',selected,
            'agentId',registration."agentId",'deviceFingerprint',registration."deviceFingerprint",
            'manufacturerId',registration."userId",'orgId',registration."orgId",
            'licenseeId',registration."licenseeId",
            'printers',CASE WHEN health_usable THEN jsonb_build_array(jsonb_build_object(
              'id',printer_row.id,'printerId',coalesce(printer_row."nativePrinterId",printer_row.id),
              'name',printer_row.name,'printerName',printer_row.name)) ELSE '[]'::jsonb END
          ),now_at
        );
        renewed := true;
      END IF;
    END IF;
    UPDATE public."PrinterAgentSession" SET "lastMessageSeq"=next_seq,"lastSeenAt"=now_at,
      "lastSignedHeartbeatAt"=CASE WHEN p_payload->>'messageType'='heartbeat' THEN now_at ELSE "lastSignedHeartbeatAt" END,
      "updatedAt"=now_at WHERE id=session_row.id;
  END IF;
  RETURN jsonb_build_object('sessionId',p_session_id,'state','CONNECTED',
    'lastMessageSeq',coalesce(next_seq,session_row."lastMessageSeq"),'attestationRenewed',renewed);
EXCEPTION WHEN NO_DATA_FOUND THEN
  RAISE EXCEPTION 'CONNECTOR_SESSION_DENIED' USING ERRCODE='42501';
END
$function$
